text:
anne (Marketing): Quick sync — launching the "Orbit" email sequence next week. Need final copy, segmentation, and webinar tie-in. Who can own the benchmark narrative? :rocket:
micah (Growth): I can draft the benchmark blurb. want it to highlight latency/cost tradeoffs vs cloud endpoints. short stat + CTA to webinar.
jordan (Content): I'll do subject line variants. leaning toward: "See how we cut inference cost by 3x" or "Benchmark: same quality, lower cost" — testing emoji vs no-emoji.
lucas (Ops): Send windows: US mornings + APAC evening stagger. proposed schedule in code block:
```
Day 0 09:00 PT -> Launch email (US)
Day 0 18:00 SGT -> Launch email (APAC, localized subject)
Day 2 10:00 PT -> Nurture 1 (case study)
Day 5 10:00 PT -> Webinar invite + reminder funnel
```
emily (Product): For the benchmark narrative, include a one-paragraph callout on real workload (prompt latency, 2k token scenario) and a mini table of unit-cost improvements. I can share numbers. Also want a short gated asset: "benchmark pack" for webinar registrants.
micah (Growth): Good — I'll write 2 variants: technical (latency/cost table) and executive (savings story + customer quote). Which should go in the first email?
anne (Marketing): Put executive variant in Launch email, technical variant in the gated benchmark pack + follow-up nurture. webinar CTA should be in both.
tara (Growth-Eng): FYI for inbound routing: set HubSpot workflow tag `orbit_warm` -> route MQLs with activity score > 50 to SDR queue `launch-orbit`. For registrants who download benchmark pack, set tag `benchmark_download`. I'll add the zap.
ops-bot: reminder: Marketing campaign `orbit-launch-v1` asset checklist incomplete: creative (x), localization (x), GDPR checkbox (x), tracking params (missing).
jordan (Content): For copy, will prepare 3 subject lines + preheader combos. Also writing a short second-paragraph that teases the benchmark pack ("download the full numbers used in the talk").
lucas (Ops): Quick question — do we need separate landing pages per region for GDPR consent? or a single page with dynamic consent?
anne (Marketing): Use dynamic consent, single page. Tara — can you confirm HubSpot form includes consent toggle and sets `consent_region`?
tara (Growth-Eng): Yep — will add `consent_region` hidden field and map to contacts. Also adding `source=orbit-email` UTM for tracking.
emily (Product): Webinar logistics: 45 min total, 25 min demo/benchmark walk-through, 15 min panel Q&A. We should prep 3 anchor prompts to show throughput/cost.
micah (Growth): Timeline check — copy freeze by EOD Fri, translations Mon, send tests Tue morning, live Wed. Is that still ok?
anne (Marketing): Agree. I'll own final QA and send tests to the list. Jordan + Micah, ping me when copy's in Google doc.
jordan (Content): Sending draft link: https://docs.google.com/... (sharing) — subject line A in there.
micah (Growth): I'll drop the exec + tech benchmark bullets in the same doc.
anne (Marketing): Great. Final note: keep the initial send light on CTAs (one clear CTA: register). Follow-ups can push the benchmark pack. :white_check_mark:
